summary: Implemented formal BRC state machine Phase 2-3: excuse_producer escape hatch, auto re-propose safety mechanisms (feature flag/debounce/max counter), approval_matrix helpers, and tracker reconstruction with auto-re-propose deduplication.
tasks_completed: TASK-1-2: Added helper methods to approval_matrix.py (get_nack_entries_for, has_unresolved_nacks_as_producer, get_latest_review_versions, ack_commit_sha)
TASK-2-2: Wired excuse_producer into signals.py (consensus_excuse_producer signal handler)
TASK-3-1: Added auto-repropose safety mechanisms (feature flag OFF by default, debounce 60s, max counter 5, overlap-aware)
TASK-3-3: Updated tracker reconstruction to debounce auto-re-propose messages during replay

test_notes.passing: 2875 orchestrator tests pass (0 failures) with the local test fixes applied

known_failures.test_peer_consensus_integration.py: 2 tests need updating: test_confirmed_reviewer_with_pre_proposal_ack_unconfirmed and test_nack_guard_with_version_zero_nack (zero-proposal guard now blocks confirmation when producer has version 0). Fix: update assertions to expect pending_acks status with zero_proposal_producers details instead of successful confirmation.
known_failures.test_producer_push_consensus.py: 19 tests fail because they create trackers without auto_repropose_enabled=True. The feature flag defaults to OFF per the plan (RISK-1 mitigation). Fix: pass auto_repropose_enabled=True in PeerConsensusTracker constructor for tests that expect auto-re-propose behavior.

implementation_notes.excuse_producer: Analogous to existing excuse_reviewer(). Removes all edges targeting the producer, cleans up proposal state, emits CONSENSUS_FAILURE event. Gated behind HITL decision requirement.
implementation_notes.auto_repropose_safety: Feature flag (auto_repropose_enabled, default False), debounce window (auto_repropose_debounce_seconds, default 60), max counter (max_auto_repropose, default 5), overlap-aware artifact checking, commit SHA comparison.
implementation_notes.tracker_reconstruction: Auto-re-propose messages tagged with trigger=auto_push are debounced during replay using 60s window to prevent version inflation from rapid pushes.
